## Current Teaching

### Math Camp 2026

I am teaching Math Camp 2026 for incoming economics graduate students. Materials, notes, and problem sets will be posted here.

#### Schedule

| Date | Topic | Materials |
|---|---|---|
| Week 1 | Sets, functions, and proof basics | Analysis lecture 1-4 |
| Week 1 | Linear algebra review | Linear Algebra lecture 1-4 |
| Week 2 | Probability review | Linear Algebra lecture 5-8 |
| Week 2 | Calculus and Analysis basic | Analysis lecture 5-7 |
| Week 3 | Probability review | Coming soon |
| Week 3 | Optimization and applications | Analysis lecture 8-10 |
